transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Cybercriminals used Claude and Grok to launch automated attacks against banks, confirmed by GBHackers News. The AI-powered system targets 400 plus Latin American financial firms.
Experts cast doubt on Anthropic report detailing how artificial intelligence has altered work at the company, reported by The Guardian.
Superintelligent artificial intelligence could be a year away, still open per شبكة تواصل الإخبارية. An ex-Google DeepMind researcher says artificial intelligence shows superhuman math skills but lacks broad intelligence.
It's been relentless say IT workers on the frontline of PHP cyber-security scramble, still open per BBC. PHP flaws trigger global cyber scramble amid artificial intelligence-driven discovery and misinformation.
OpenAI's artificial intelligence agents analysed a mouse brain gene atlas in 32 minutes, reported by The Next Web. 2,000 artificial intelligence agents analyzed mouse brain data in 32 minutes, finding new neuroscience leads.
